note: Original GetEdge work, distilled from the pipeline used to edit Federico De Ponte's own San Francisco vlog shorts and the Edge launch reel. The cut judge, the editing grammar and every enforced rule come from real renders that were reviewed, called broken, fixed and re-judged. No code was copied from another project. Fonts are not bundled: `vlog.py setup` downloads Inter 4.1 (SIL Open Font License) from its official release. Map tiles come from OpenStreetMap at render time and must be attributed on screen.
